top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and identification of the active peptide (Holst, Drucker, Mojsov) is an original, replicated discovery chain that changed the field and is now confirmed by large outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease; it is mature, and the three-person allocation is defensible, with attribution of the active peptide a real but citation-manageable weakness. No award is clearly inferior.
